matches.rationale: No finding addresses the VBench score discrepancy or lack of statistical reporting; Finding 1 concerns a different speedup contradiction.
Finding 2 directly captures the logical inconsistency in Equation (2) omitting conditioning on previous clip tokens, exactly matching the ground-truth error.
No finding mentions missing train/validation splits, dataset biases, or proportions in the training data description.
No finding reports the absence of prompt rewriting details or confidence intervals in VBench comparisons.
No finding notes the unfair baselines due to resolution and parameter size asymmetry in the efficiency comparison table.
The claim of being the first discrete AR 720p video generator is not questioned by any finding.
None of the findings discuss the underspecification of Stochastic Quantizer Depth dropout probabilities or loss adjustments.
No finding addresses missing ethical review, consent, or bias considerations for the training datasets.
The conclusion's overstatement about outperforming diffusion and tenfold speedup is not captured; Finding 1 shows a speedup mismatch but not the broader rhetorical overclaim.
The promotional language in the introduction is not flagged by any finding.
The ambiguity between spatial-only vs. temporal scale extension is not mentioned in the findings.
No finding mentions missing confidence intervals or significance tests for the GenEval/DPG results.
No finding identifies potentially fabricated 2025+ citations in the references.

Finding 3 shows that the stated speedup figures for Spacetime Sparse Attention are unsupported or inconsistent with Table 5, directly evidencing the rhetorical overpromotion of the method beyond substantiated claims.
No finding notes missing training details such as optimizer type, weight decay, or hardware.
No finding addresses the lack of quantitative evaluation for zero-shot video extrapolation.
